title: Vibrant Brazilian Pilaf
description: A colorful and flavorful Brazilian-inspired pilaf dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Brazilian-style seasoning
ingredients.notes: Available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the yellow onion and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the green beans and cook for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Add the vibrant rice, Brazilian-style seasoning, and pilaf seasoning to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
